Hero.quote: "By wearing one of my creations, you carry with you the earth's vibration, the whisper of the Andean wind, and the protection of ancestral guardians."

PhilosophyStrip.text: 925 SILVER IS THE CANVAS. THE STONES, THE SOUL. MOCHICA ART, THE LEGACY.

Artesano.title: The Artisan
Artesano.p1: with a mission that goes beyond jewelry: to create pieces in 925 silver with semi-precious stones that not only adorn, but
Artesano.p2: The first steps were not easy. A small space, limited resources, family life interwoven with every hammer strike. But Yonatan never stopped believing that every obstacle was, in reality, a lesson. And so, with the same patience used to work metal — strike by strike, with fire and faith — the workshop grew.
Artesano.p3_bold: L'Atelier Peruano is a benchmark of artisanal jewelry in Switzerland
Artesano.p3: . Not because it follows trends, but because it proudly ignores them. Because here, jewelry is not manufactured. Amulets are created. Stories are engraved. Memories of a people who mastered metalwork centuries before the industry existed are transmitted.
Artesano.p4: The Mochica spirit lives in every silver carved feather.

Litoterapia.title: Lithotherapy:
Litoterapia.subtitle: Energy of the Earth
Litoterapia.description: Every stone is a natural antenna. I personally select semi-precious stones not only for their beauty but for their vibrations and ancient healing properties documented in Andean and global traditions.
